##### Project general facts

Vida Residences Saadiyat Island is a contemporary, pet-friendly residential building curated for lifestyle seekers, global citizens and cultural enthusiasts. Signature contemporary architecture with flowing lines, panoramic windows and inviting public spaces creates a calm, design-led atmosphere where culture, comfort and community combine. The building rises above a podium level to six residential floors and a roof, offering a limited collection of one-, two- and three-bedroom residences with views towards the beach and the cultural landmarks of the island.

Amenities are designed to uplift and inspire. Residents can stay active in the indoor and outdoor gym, unwind by the main pool and sun deck, and gather with friends in the indoor club lounge and multipurpose room. Families benefit from a kids' pool, kids' splash pads, an outdoor kids' play area and an outdoor gaming area, while a barbecue area, a dog park and retail and food and beverage shops complete a lively, community-focused lifestyle.

Residences are finished with a contemporary eye for detail, combining sophistication with ease. Bright living areas and open kitchens are framed by large windows, while bedrooms and bathrooms offer calm, refined spaces. Homes are delivered fully furnished. Premium services include round-the-clock security and concierge, doorman and porter services, housekeeping, laundry and dry cleaning, on-site property management, parcel handling, pet care and grooming, and grocery delivery coordination.

##### Location description and benefits

Saadiyat Island is Abu Dhabi's cultural heart, blending world-class museums, pristine beaches and natural landscapes into a calm and inspiring setting. Louvre Abu Dhabi, Zayed National Museum, Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, the Abrahamic Family House and Manarat Al Saadiyat sit within the cultural district, while Saadiyat Beach offers soft white sand and clear waters along a protected shoreline where hawksbill turtles nest.

NYU Abu Dhabi, Harrow School and the Saadiyat Beach Golf Club are close by, and Jubail Mangrove Park is a short drive away. Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Highway connects the island with Abu Dhabi Global Market, Al Reem Island, Yas Island and Yas Mall, the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and Zayed International Airport, all within comfortable driving distance, keeping the wider capital close at hand.

Saadiyat Island is an investment zone open to international buyers and one of the most prestigious addresses in the UAE. A thriving cultural scene, premium schools and beachfront leisure attract professionals, families and creatives, supporting strong rental demand. Limited supply of furnished, service-led residences close to the cultural district underpins long-term value and resilient resale prospects for owners and investors alike.
